content:
May was a truly busy and productive month, connecting with our key Global OTA partners across a series of meetings and industry events.

It started with a meeting with Booking.com and Etraveli Group, where we exchanged on our shared priorities with the customer firmly at the centre of the conversation.

This was followed by attending the Trip.com Airline Partner Conference in Amsterdam. It was an excellent event, opened by our CCO Adriaan den Heijer, and included a valuable meeting with Group CEO Jane Sun. The central theme of the conference — co-creating value through intelligence, trust, and partnership strongly resonated. 

Finally, we attended the Expedia Group EXPLORE event, where senior leadership shared perspectives on Expedia’s evolution over the past 30 years and future direction. We had the opportunity to engage with senior leaders across Expedia and finished off with a fantastic dinner with Expedia and JV partners, Delta Air Lines and Virgin Atlantic.

Overall, a strong month of collaboration, insight sharing, and continued partnership development across our key OTA ecosystem.  

Many Thanks to everyone who spent their valuable time with me through the month and I look forward to our next opportunity to meet Meletis Michelakakis Paul Meijer Henk Van der Velde Laia Martinez Marina Novoseltseva Rafael Bence Raphael de Vannoise Ilenia Rodo Sandeep Sharma James Marshall John Price Patrick Reid Marc Koesling
personaInterest: Collaboration and partnership growth within the travel and hospitality ecosystem
keyTakeaway: Target key decision-makers at major Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) to explore potential partnership opportunities and collaborative growth strategies.
